fit_space: linear sRGB, current to same-tooth same-view S0
annotation_transfer: Reviewed placement by capture event. Phase correlation on structural edges checks that repeated shots retain the event framing.
weighting: Each physical material has equal total weight. Each accepted physical block on that material has equal weight.
independent_check: The whole notched disc is held out. The old root fit and the material fit both exclude this object. Archived withheld untreated-root tiles are a second, separate mid/light check.
threshold_origin: Engineering settings for this implementation of the chat brief. The minimum channel span is inherited from the historical RGB run. Eligibility is fixed before reading calibration outcomes.
